scope: offline market-behavior event study; no strategy, positions or PnL

source.new_2020_2023: official public Binance Spot GET https://data-api.binance.vision/api/v3/klines?symbol={symbol}&interval=4h&startTime={ms}&endTime={ms}&limit=1000; only 2020-01-01..2024-01-01; 8 fixed symbols; immutable raw pages and SHA manifest
source.download_limit: at most 80,000 new 4h rows, 90 GET pages, 30 MiB raw JSON; no futures or other markets

daily_aggregation: UTC midnight-aligned groups of exactly six consecutive complete 4h Spot bars; open first, high max, low min, close last, volume sum; reject partial days; 4h open at 00/04/08/12/16/20 UTC and close at next boundary minus 1ms
listing: first actual complete 4h bar returned by official source is first eligible bar; no invented prelisting candles, no common-start truncation for per-symbol analysis; H5 active universe requires >=30 completed calendar days and >=5 eligible assets; common-period analysis separately uses 2023-06-01..2025-12-31, subject to actual PEPE listing

features.volatility: trailing 30-day standard deviation of completed log returns, 4h rolling 180 bars * sqrt(6), daily rolling 30 bars; exclude current from regime percentile baseline
features.normalized_move: 7-day log close return divided by trailing daily-scale sigma30*sqrt(7), computed from completed bars only
features.vol_state: rank current sigma30 against strictly preceding 180 calendar days of sigma30 (1080 4h or 180 daily bars); low <1/3, normal <=2/3, high >2/3
features.btc_regime: same-boundary BTC 30-day normalized return: up >0.5, down <-0.5, otherwise neutral; diagnostic only
features.range_state: 30-day pre-event high-low range divided by pre-event close, ranked against strictly preceding 180 such completed range observations; compressed if percentile <=0.25
features.trend_pullback: 30-day normalized return ending 3 days before event, using sigma30 then; pullback is current 3-day normalized return against that prior trend

hypotheses.H1_H2: same episodes: abs(normalized 7-day move)>=2, direction=sign(move); H1 expects directional forward excess >0 (continuation), H2 expects <0 (reversal); control moderate same-direction moves 0.5<=abs(z)<1.5 in same symbol/year/vol_state; one two-sided family test, not two opportunities
hypotheses.H3: pre-event 30-day range percentile<=0.25, current completed candle close beyond preceding 30-day high/low; direction=breakout side; control other same-side 30-day breakouts with range percentile>0.25 in same symbol/year/vol_state
hypotheses.H4: abs(pre-pullback 30-day z)>=1.5; current 3-day z opposite prior trend, normalized magnitude 0.5..1.5; direction=prior trend; control same trend-sign and vol_state, current 3-day signed z in [-0.5,0.5] in same symbol/year
hypotheses.H5: every 14 UTC days anchored 2020-01-01T00:00Z, rank active assets by past 30-day normalized return; top two, middle, bottom two; primary effect=(mean top future Spot return - mean bottom future Spot return)/2; no prelisting membership, min active assets 5; 4h and daily use 00:00 UTC decisions

episodes: H1/H2, H3, H4 first qualifying observation per symbol/family then 14 calendar-day cooldown; H5 one cross-section each 14-day scheduled timestamp. Controls may be more frequent and are not event entries.
targets: primary Spot next-open to close of seventh completed future UTC day (4h=42 bars, 1d=7 bars), percent; H1-H4 direction-adjusted, H5 half long-short spread. Secondary signed 4h 6/18 bars and 1d 1/3/14 bars plus primary-horizon absolute return, MFE from future highs, MAE from future lows. Neither event candle nor current close counted as forward profit; no TP/SL.
splits_and_purge: 2020-22 discovery, 2023-25 validation (separate yearly folds), 2026 diagnostic; forward horizon must finish strictly before segment end, no cross-boundary outcomes, no random split or feature tuning; 2024-26 previously researched and validation is not pristine external holdout
control_matching: H1-H4 per-event mean of all eligible non-event control observations in same symbol, UTC year, trailing vol_state and directional side/trend sign; if none, exclude event from primary excess and count unmatched. BTC regime up/down is reported separately, not selected on; H5 compares ranks on the same timestamp.

costs.H5_note: H5 half-spread averages two legs, so the same per-leg 0.30/0.60 percentage-point hurdle is subtracted from half-spread; no portfolio PnL claim

primary_comparisons: H1/H2 competing signed excess vs matched control, H3 directional excess, H4 directional excess, H5 half-spread; all at 7-day horizon and 4h/1d; 8 independent family-by-timeframe tests, H1/H2 counted once; secondary horizons descriptive only
uncertainty: UTC calendar-month block bootstrap 1000 resamples, seed 20261028, all symbols and concurrent events in same month block; two-sided test for H1/H2 and one-sided positive for H3-H5; Holm familywise adjustment across 8 primary tests; overlapping forward windows and shared BTC exposure remain limitations

pass.PROMISING: expected-sign validation matched excess >=0.6pp; positive after 0.3pp raw hurdle; Holm p<0.05 and 95% month-block CI expected sign; >=2/3 validation years expected sign; >=5/8 symbols expected sign for H1-H4 (H5 leave-one-out), all leave-one-symbol-out expected sign; sufficient N/months; without best event expected sign; BTC-up and BTC-down diagnostic both expected sign if each has >=30 events
pass.ROBUST: not available from this already researched history; would require genuinely unseen prospective confirmation
pass.WEAK: expected-sign effect >0 but PROMISING conditions absent
pass.REJECT: zero or wrong-sign validation effect or insufficient data for a meaningful test
pass.overall: PROMISING_HIGHER_TIMEFRAME_HYPOTHESIS_FOUND if any PROMISING; else WEAK_HIGHER_TIMEFRAME_EFFECTS_ONLY if any WEAK; else NO_HIGHER_TIMEFRAME_EDGE_FOUND

anti_leakage: all feature windows trailing and closed; thresholds fixed above; no future/listing backfill; UTC exact joins; event cooldown causal; outcome starts next open; no future candle in event definition; no post-result threshold/parameter search
safety: research files only; no production, technical-v1, PAPER, SQLite, DeepSeek, orders, commit or push
